subject: Emotions
title: Joy vs Happiness
description: A 60-second lesson on Joy vs Happiness.

hook.text: Happiness is getting a promotion. Joy is laughing so hard you can't breathe. They feel different—and they are.

buildup.text: Happiness is a state tied to circumstances. Joy is a spike—a sudden, intense burst that doesn't need a reason.

discovery.text: Psychologist Paul Ekman found joy has a unique facial signature: genuine eye crinkles called Duchenne smiles.

twist.text: You can be happy without feeling joy, and you can feel moments of joy during unhappy periods. They're independent.

climax.text: Joy is evolutionarily older than happiness. Even rats show joy responses during play—leaping and chirping.

punchline.text: Happiness is a weather report. Joy is lightning.

quiz.question: What facial feature marks genuine joy according to Ekman?
